in_marathi.name: Karthi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Karthi means 'Son of God'. This powerful name is derived from the Hindu deity Kartikeya, also known as Murugan or Skanda, who is the god of war, courage, and wisdom. Karthi embodies the divine qualities of bravery, strength, and intelligence.
